evidence.title: vllm-project/vllm: v0.28.0: [CI/Build] Pin Cython below 3.3 for arm64 tilelang sdist (#53358)

summary: The open-source vllm inference engine updates to version 0.28.0, adding a build change that pins Cython to versions below 3.3 to ensure compatibility with ARM64 tile language source distributions. This adjustment aims to improve stability for users running the library on ARM‑based hardware.
title: vllm 0.28.0 released with Cython version lock for ARM64 builds
